Definition: a head person (of any rank or class)
BiblicalUsage: Sar is a prince, a ruler, a head man — the word for the rulers of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens that Moses set over Israel. And it reaches its height in the child whose name is called the Prince of Peace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word runs the whole length of Scripture, from the rulers men appoint to the one Ruler God promised, and only the Prince of Peace rules the way a ruler should.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
